title: Consciousness first evolved to estimate system and world states

statements.text: Consciousness first evolved to generate estimates of likely system and world states, conditioned on a causal world model trained on histories of interaction. Its first function may have been data fusion that structures experience for action selection and credit assignment, with unlimited associative learning as a secondary function.

sources.quote: IWMT suggests that consciousness first evolved as a means of generating estimates of likely system-world states, conditioned on a causal world model trained via histories of experience with environmental interactions
